title: A filter over the whole table (FILTER ( Product, ... )) inherits the existing filter on Product
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Table filter] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], FILTER ( 'Product', 'Product'[Color] = "Blue" || 'Product'[Category] = "Vehicles" ) )

source.quote: Using a table filter, you inherit the filter argument existing for the Product table
source.supports: FILTER ( Product, ... ) iterates the products visible under the existing filter, so that filter is kept

derivation: Products that are Blue or Vehicles: Bike, Lock, Scooter. On the Vehicles row Product holds Bike and Scooter; both pass: Bike 400 + Scooter BLANK = 400. On the Accessories row Product holds Helmet and Lock; only Lock passes: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
